title: AI Director
description:
London, Hybrid

A leading UK retail banking organisation is undertaking a major transformation programme to redefine how marketing operates through AI, automation, data and next-generation operating models. This engagement offers the opportunity to shape strategic thinking at executive level, helping define the future of AI-enabled marketing operations within a complex and highly regulated environment.


The Company

They are a major financial services organisation investing heavily in technology, automation and customer experience transformation. As part of a broader enterprise-wide change agenda, they are exploring how Agentic AI and intelligent automation can transform marketing operations, decision-making and organisational effectiveness. This programme has strong executive sponsorship and will play a significant role in shaping future operating models across the business.

The Role and Deliverables

  • Define the vision for AI-enabled marketing operations within a large retail banking environment.
  • Design future-state operating models that improve agility, effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for Agentic AI, Generative AI and intelligent automation across marketing functions.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to senior executives, providing external perspectives and challenging conventional thinking.
  • Lead transformation discussions spanning people, process, technology, governance and organisational design.
  • Develop practical transformation roadmaps that align strategic ambitions with delivery in a regulated financial services environment.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience leading large-scale business, operating model or digital transformation programmes.
  • Deep understanding of Agentic AI, Generative AI, workflow automation and process redesign.
  • Proven capability in shaping future operating models within large, complex organisations.
  • Experience advising C-suite stakeholders on transformation, innovation and strategic change initiatives.
  • Ability to influence senior leadership teams and build alignment across multiple business functions.
  • Experience within banking, financial services, telecommunications, retail or similarly complex customer-focused sectors.
  • Consulting Partner, Managing Director, Transformation Director or equivalent executive-level experience.

How to Apply

If you have a track record of leading enterprise-wide transformation and helping organisations realise the potential of AI-enabled operating models, apply today to discuss this opportunity further.
